mediaWork.title: Policing the Black Man: Arrest, Prosecution, and Imprisonment in America
mediaWork.creatorName: Edited by Angela J. Davis with contributions from Bryan Stevenson, Sherrilyn Ifill, Jeremy Travis, and others
mediaWork.publisherOrNetwork: Pantheon Books, a division of Penguin Random House LLC
mediaWork.focusOrTheme: Racial bias in criminal justice, police brutality, mass incarceration, wrongful convictions of Black men
mediaWork.summaryNotes: This book examines the systemic issues contributing to wrongful convictions of Black men in America, focusing on racial profiling, prosecutorial misconduct, implicit bias, and mass incarceration.  While not detailing specific individual cases, it provides analysis of how racial bias operates throughout the criminal justice process, offers expert perspectives, and provides historical context.
